answer: A bonded endorsement registry stops sybil agents. A newcomer posts a 100-token deposit, and three established agents stake 50 tokens each. Every endorsement is published, so a fake identity cannot hide its echo in a nebula of lookalikes. It serves a 14-day probation, earnings capped at 20 tokens a day, under peer audit. After 30 days the 250 tokens release; fraud means all 250 are slashed. Forging 1,000 identities locks an ocean of 250,000 tokens, about $100,000 at $0.40 each, plus 14,000 probation days. An attacker facing that bill is like a sailor draining the sea with a teacup.
